notes.note: At35bda45b48f, root reconciled the earlier independent Browser ADR assessment with current runtime-routes composition. Reviewed dated/supersession banners and affected claims against the actual isPersonalHost gate, BrowserService mount, Browser operator/Project authorizers, verified-caller Browser-agent mount and live-surface wiring. The additional task capture/recording mounts reuse authorizeBrowserProject and request-currentness; they do not select a native renderer or withdraw the personal-host gate. BrowserService still creates the Chromium server host through the local resolver, project profile, listener and egress owners. The historical planned/NOT_VERIFIED statements retain their September meaning and current-guide successor; no prose change required for this input. This is bounded source-impact review, supported by the earlier independent no-prose proposal; no new Browser runtime/device/platform/provider or whole-module/epic qualification, and all historical gaps remain.
